_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "podcast_rows" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "author" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "artwork_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "feed_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "episode_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "website_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "categories_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "explicit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("explicit" IN (0, 1)), "podcast_index_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "discovery_cache_rows" ("feed_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "podcast_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "episodes_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "cached_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("feed_url"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "episode_rows" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "podcast_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES podcast_rows (id), "podcast_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "artwork_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "audio_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "published_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "position_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "queued" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("queued" IN (0, 1)), "downloaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("downloaded" IN (0, 1)), "is_youtube" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_youtube" IN (0, 1)), "chapters_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "playback_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "playback_device_id" TEXT NULL, "playback_intent" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'progress', "playback_media_identity" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download_job_rows" ("episode_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES episode_rows (id), "source_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "partial_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes_downloaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "etag" TEXT NULL, "last_modified" TEXT NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, "automatic" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("automatic" IN (0, 1)), "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "played_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("episode_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download_preference_rows" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "automatic" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("automatic" IN (0, 1)), "episode_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "wifi_only" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("wifi_only" IN (0, 1)), "charging_only" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("charging_only" IN (0, 1)), "storage_floor_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 524288000, "retention" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'never', "retention_delay_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 24, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "podcast_download_override_rows" ("podcast_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES podcast_rows (id), "automatic" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("automatic" IN (0, 1)), "episode_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wifi_only" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("wifi_only" IN (0, 1)), "charging_only" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("charging_only" IN (0, 1)), "storage_floor_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "retention" TEXT NOT NULL, "retention_delay_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("podcast_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queue_rows" ("episode_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES episode_rows (id), "sort_key" REAL NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("episode_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inbox_rows" ("episode_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES episode_rows (id), "discovered_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "removed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("episode_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inbox_preference_rows" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "left_action" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'remove', "right_action" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queue', "mark_removed_as_played" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("mark_removed_as_played" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "podcast_inbox_override_rows" ("podcast_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES podcast_rows (id), "left_action" TEXT NULL, "right_action" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("podcast_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_mutations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "episode_id" INTEGER NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "failed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queue_sync_state_rows" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_device_rows" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playback_preference_rows" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "speed" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "skip_silence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'off', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "podcast_playback_override_rows" ("podcast_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES podcast_rows (id), "speed" REAL NULL, "skip_silence" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("podcast_id"));
